title: Object from Parts · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Object from Parts · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar object visible in the room. The lead describes two visible parts without naming the object. Another player identifies the intended object. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Object from Parts, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Another player identifies the intended object.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Another player identifies the intended object.
